source: class_ro_t.instanceSize and ivar_t offsets in the app image

ivarAccess.mechanism: compiled code loads ivar offsets from _OBJC_IVAR_$<Class>._<ivar> slots at runtime; the runtime patches the slots when it realizes the class
ivarAccess.evidence: adrp/ldrsw of the slot symbol followed by add, observed in Xcode 27.1 clang output for SDK-superclass ivars
ivarAccess.consequence: the runtime must realize guest classes and patch the slots; Apple's absolute instance sizes are not baked into the app's code
